COST: 412

The only roads that connect to the car's position are the open roads to Myagang and Gajuri, and both are dead ends. Those two elderly people can be reached and rescued at Thakre shelter. Tarkeshwar hospital, Likhu farm, Suryagadhi and Panchakanya can't be reached because every road to them is damaged, so those 10 people are deferred.

Driving: 24 + 24 + 7 + 7 = 62 minutes. Penalties: 2 injured × 80 + 1 elderly × 50 + 7 adults × 20 = 350. Total: 62 + 350 = 412.
